references.text: The context for baldness (קָרַחַת) and the bare forehead area (גַבַּחַת) mentioned in verse 42, where these terms are first introduced.
Continuation of the examination of leprosy on a bald head, where the priest is to declare the person unclean based on the appearance described in verse 42.
Basic regulations concerning leprosy (צָרַעַת) on the skin with white and reddish spots, which form the basis for the diagnosis in verse 42.
Parallel description of a white-reddish (לָבָן אֲדַמְדָּם) skin disease and an outbreak of leprosy (צָרַעַת פֹּרַחַת).
Summary of the laws concerning leprosy, including bald areas, which provide the broader legal framework for verse 42.
